label: conformance vectors for the gates scorers and the table cover; no claim

rules.match: a row matches an assignment when every (gate, value) of its when has fired[gate] == value, the scorers' expression; the earliest matching row lands
rules.expect: holes: assignments no row matches; landings[i]: assignments landing on row i; total: holes == 0; unreachable_rows: rows with no landing; over 2 ** len(gates) assignments
rules.brute: true: expect is brute force over every assignment (replay.brute_force); false: expect is the closed form the generator states for the table's shape
